text: Fixing #6511 and #6591 together: installed VFP9 09.00.0000.7423 discards the FIRST CSV line unconditionally (BOM/quoted-BOM/LF/CR/blank/mismatched headers; a no-header file loses its first data row; header-only and BOM+data-only give 0 rows), so APPEND FROM TYPE CSV now skips the first record on both local-table and SQL/result-cursor paths instead of only when it matched the target names. 20 new exact-byte cases fail before (16 local, 6 SQL) and pass after; full local suite 399/400 (one slow audit-stream test times out only under load). Evidence tables posted on both issues; a quoted header with an embedded newline and VFP error 47 on an empty file are left unspecified pending owner decision.
